dates.event: Start of the NFL league year

dates.note: Trades must be accepted by the end of this game.

yearly: Owner's Meeting before the NFL season, in March: rule changes and votes, trophies, and the draft order is set. Firm handshakes and hearty laughs all around.
New season kicks off: FAAB resets and waivers open weekly.
NFL Draft, then the league's rookie draft.
NFL preseason starts: waivers move to daily and taxi squads are confirmed.
Week 16 ends and a new champion is crowned. Congrats on the jersey.
Deadzone: waivers and trades are off until the next Owner's Meeting.

rules.title: Scoring
items: Half PPR, full PPR for tight ends (+0.5 per TE catch)
Passing: 4 points per TD, 0.04 per yard (1 point per 25 yards)
Rushing and receiving: 6 points per TD, 0.1 per yard
2 points per two-point conversion
Interception thrown: −1
Fumble lost: −2

rules.title: Roster
items: Starters: QB, 2 RB, 3 WR, TE, 2 FLEX, 1 SUPERFLEX
17 bench spots
4 IR spots. The player must be on the NFL's IR or PUP list.

4 taxi squad spots, rookies only. Set them before Week 1; once the season starts nobody can be moved onto the taxi squad, but you can move a player off it anytime you have a legal roster. After one year of NFL experience a player must leave the taxi squad (roster, drop or trade).

rules.title: Schedule and playoffs
items: One division of 8 teams. Balanced schedule: everyone plays every team twice.
Playoffs in Weeks 15 and 16. Four teams, one-week matchups.
The bottom four play a consolation bracket.

rules.title: Rookie draft order
items: Playoff teams pick by inverse playoff finish. The champion picks 8th.
Non-playoff teams pick by Max Points For at the end of the regular season (best possible lineup, not starters). Lowest Max PF picks 1st, so benching your starters doesn't help you tank.
Pick 2.09 goes to the winner of the consolation bracket.
Pick 3.09 goes to the team with the most points against in the regular season.

rules.title: Rookie draft
items: Rookies only, 4 rounds, linear (not snake), 5 minutes per pick.
Trades are allowed during the draft, and each team gets one 5-minute pause.
Current and future picks can be traded.
2026 draft: June 22, 8:15 PM.

rules.title: Transactions
items: Players lock at the start of their game each week and unlock Wednesday at 12 PM.
Tuesday night is the first waiver run each week; after that waivers process daily at 12 PM. Players clear waivers after 1 day.
No limit on transactions. No trade vetoes; trades truly worth discussing go to a league vote.
Trade deadline: Week 12.
FAAB: $200 per season, reset once after the Super Bowl, no carryover. $0 bids allowed.
Waiver priority follows draft order (1.01 has the lowest priority). A claim sends you to the back; priority breaks ties on equal bids.
Waivers stay open year-round except the deadzone between the championship and the Owner's Meeting.
